svg.title: LLMSlim: the context layer for production AI agents
svg.desc: Open source Python library. pip install llmslim. 212× lower cost than Mem0 (Mem0's LongMemEval questions), 42× lower cost, same accuracy (vs full history, LongMemEval), 3× fewer tokens, same score (LongBench v1), +21 points over LLMLingua-2 (NaturalQuestions, same budget).

g.text: Compress, plan and budget what the model sees, from
prompts and chat history to RAG chunks, tool schemas and
agent memory. It runs inside your own process: no API key,
no network call, deterministic by default.
1,648 TESTS · 93% BRANCH COVERAGE · CLAUDE CODE, LANGCHAIN, LLAMAINDEX, HAYSTACK, MCP
